scope.foveaCandidate: versioned target-specific derived-raster persistence with exact-pixel fallback to original decode
excludedClaims: performance conclusions from the exploratory 2026-08 prototype

measurementBoundary.start: immediately before constructing the comparator load
measurementBoundary.adapterReturn: library callback or async result returns a target-sized image
measurementBoundary.displayReady: the returned CGImage has completed a full normalized sRGB pixel draw into a bounded target-sized surface
measurementBoundary.reason: Adapters differ in eager versus lazy rasterization. Adapter-return latency alone is not a semantically sufficient display-readiness boundary.

hardGates: all loads complete with exact target bounds
orientation and color reference probes pass
cold, warm-disk, and warm-memory outputs for the same RenderKey have identical normalized pixel digests
one eligible origin fetch per source identity class across W11 targets
no-store and credentialed responses never create unauthorized derived persistence
namespace revocation removes or renders unreachable every derived artifact
generation changes cannot resurrect stale derived artifacts
corrupt or unknown derived formats fail closed to original decode
derived creation never delays first display
cancellation closes publication before any late derived artifact becomes reachable
derived persistent bytes remain within the configured Fovea soft budget after alias-aware physical deduplication and eviction
eviction cannot leave a Fovea alias pointing at a deliberately removed derived physical blob
write-rate and write-amplification remain within the preregistered budget
logical derived write-window reservations survive reopen and reject before blob staging when exhausted
measured total physical write bytes include budget metadata, Fovea manifest, Akashic metadata, filesystem effects, eviction and recovery rather than treating the logical gate as a device-byte oracle
fixed-window boundary bursts remain within the preregistered physical write and latency envelope

coldPath.criterion: non-inferior to the best eligible comparator with a preregistered device-specific margin
machine-checkable optimum of one request per eligible source identity class
non-inferior to the best eligible comparator

warmDisk.criterion: endpoint-by-endpoint dominance target; no aggregate-score substitution
measured after identical source and target preparation
measured after identical source and target preparation
reported with bytes; not a standalone winner metric

warmDisk.endpoint: derived creation CPU time and written bytes
warmDisk.criterion: amortized only over observed later hits; speculative future hits are forbidden

warmMemory.criterion: derived persistence must not materially regress the existing memory-hit path

lifecycle.endpoint: reclaim latency after cancellation or revoke
lifecycle.criterion: bounded and reported separately from foreground latency

admissionPolicyToTest.minimumObservedReuseCohort: at least the conservative ceiling of creation cost divided by measured per-hit decode savings, with an additional safety margin
admissionPolicyToTest.formatSelection: choose among versioned exact-pixel formats per artifact using bounded creation work, resulting bytes, expected hits, and measured read cost; no globally fixed format
budgets: maximum in-flight source and output bytes
maximum creation CPU time per admission window
maximum write bytes per source generation
admissionPolicyToTest.fallback: original encoded representation remains authoritative and immediately usable

formalExecutionRequirements.source: clean exact revisions with source-tree identity
formalExecutionRequirements.ordering: balanced interleaving with randomized or Latin-square comparator order
formalExecutionRequirements.host: quiescence and thermal gates must pass
statistics: multiplicity correction within each preregistered endpoint family
TOST or confidence-interval non-inferiority where applicable

exploratoryEvidence.role: mechanism discovery and counterexample source only

policyMechanismEvidence.implemented: alias-aware physical-byte budget with shared-container deduplication and in-memory second chance
policyMechanismEvidence.claimBoundary: mechanism and regression evidence only; no comparator performance claim
